arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT 'bookings' AS source, json_group_array(json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'ref',b.client_reference,'hold',h.booking_id)) AS rows FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('flight',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'errors',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'status',status,'message',message)) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE status >=400 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10)

SELECT 'config' AS source,json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) AS rows FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'ref',b.client_reference,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'created',c.created_step)) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts)) FROM (SELECT * FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' ORDER BY event_id LIMIT 6) UNION ALL SELECT 'errors',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'status',status,'message',message)) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE status>=400 AND service='checkin' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 4)

SELECT 'outbox' AS source,json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts)) AS rows FROM (SELECT * FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' ORDER BY event_id LIMIT 3) UNION ALL SELECT 'errors',json_group_array(json_object('status',status,'message',message)) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service='checkin' AND status>=400 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancellations',json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'event',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e JOIN bookings b USING(request_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config

SELECT 'booking_totals' AS check_name,json_object('confirmed',sum(status='confirmed'),'pending',sum(status='pending'),'cancelled',sum(status='cancelled')) AS result FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'confirmed_missing_backing',json_group_array(b.booking_id) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.flight_id=b.flight_id AND c.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled',json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'has_cancel',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'amount',c.amount_cents)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'refunds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge',r.charge_id,'amount',r.amount_cents)) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sales',json_group_array(client_reference) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold',json_group_array(f.flight_id) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox_status',json_group_array(json_object('status',status,'count',n)) FROM (SELECT status,count(*) n FROM outbox GROUP BY status)
